Class CustomerDTO

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.dto.CustomerDTO
public class CustomerDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing customer information. Used to transfer customer data between layers without exposing the domain model. Includes customer details and membership card information.
